title: citrus × limetta var. parva
intro: Citrus × limetta var. parva, commonly known as dwarf sour orange, is a small, evergreen shrub or tree belonging to the Rutaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include numerous health benefits such as improving digestion, reducing inflammation, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Citrus × limetta var. parva include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities, which may help to soothe digestive issues, fight infections, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
